title: Golf Ball Picker 80 cm – with Carry Bag
descriptionHtml:
100 balls on the ground. A back that says no.

The practice session was great – until it's time to pick up. Bending over a hundred times is nobody's idea of a good finish.

The solution: roll – done

Roll the picker over the balls and they're caught in the basket, one by one. A hundred balls in a few minutes – without your back even noticing.

Features

  • A hundred balls without bending your back
  • Comfortable working height – 80 cm shaft
  • Many balls before emptying – large basket
  • Easy to take along – detachable, carry bag included
  • For the range, the garden and the practice field
